description: Dual clock manipulator: two sections take the one shared clock and each either swings it or multiplies or divides it, on up to sixteen polyphonic channels at once

params.text: Sets that section's amount: swing from 50% to 70% across the knob, or a clock factor from eight times at the far left through unity at centre to a division by eight at the far right
Switches that section between swinging the clock and multiplying or dividing it

Resets that section on each press: with the section swinging, the next clock edge is passed through unswung; with it multiplying or dividing, the next edge is passed through and the count starts again

inputs.text: A rising edge past 2V resets both sections
The clock both sections work from, read as a rising edge past 2V; the channel count of this cable sets the module's polyphony
Adds to that section's knob, 10V covering the whole knob range

outputs.text: That section's manipulated clock, as 10V pulses; the other jack of the pair carries the same signal

notes: nothing comes out until a cable is patched to CLK.: both sections are driven by that one input and the module does no work without it.
bypassing the module copies the CLK. input to all four outputs unaltered.
the lamp between a section's outputs shows what produced each pulse: one the section generated, or one passed straight through from the clock.
menu: LEDs channel — picks which polyphonic channel the section lamps report
